title: Pilot Joystick
text: 在 Windows 平台上提供操纵杆接口；输出 4 路；按 {Sample time} 指定采样时间；{Joystick ID} 指定操纵杆 ID、{Output configuration} 指定操纵杆输出配置，按实例取值。

params.name: Joystick ID
params.values: 操纵杆 ID Joystick1 (default) | Joystick2 | Joystick3 | Joystick4 | Joystick5 | Joystick6 | Joystick7 | Joystick8 | Joystick9 | Joystick10 | Joystick11 | Joystick12 | Joystick13 | Joystick14 | Joystick15 | Joystick16 | None

params.name: Output configuration
params.values: 操纵杆输出配置 FourAxis (default) | AllOutputs
